request.purpose: Policy-making: planning hospital capacity and care pathways for the coming years.
request.question: What is the mean cholesterol of patients with type 2 diabetes, by region?
definitions: Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest total cholesterol per patient.
Report per region: patients with type 2 diabetes who have a cholesterol value and their mean cholesterol, one decimal.
